item.text: Use published concentrations as context for your laboratory result. Match the measurement and reference below. A reference made from study summaries does not establish a percentile for an individual lot.

cells: Choose the same species and rice form in the [contamination table](#heavy-metal-contamination-profile). Match the dry-weight, native-moisture or cooked basis shown with the finding.

Open the comparison information icon for the reference median, quartiles, sampling unit, markets and collection period. Compare compatible values as context. The badge classifies the published finding; a lot result does not inherit that rating.

Use [origin and harvest evidence](#rice-sourcing-differences) to investigate supplier or control options. Check [applicable requirements](#rice-requirements) separately. If the reference or reporting bounds do not support a position, retain the result without a rating.
